scope: Mac capture presentation handoff across SwiftUI destination-view replacement. Framework/model proof and unsigned app builds; installed widget route is not accepted.
problem: Root switches to Inbox and increments a counter in one update; the detail view is keyed by section. The replacement Inbox listener starts with the incremented value and the old onChange default omits initial execution.
change: Retain one workspace-bound destination request; initial and subsequent listeners consume it only in the correct surface. Cancel on navigation/account reset, reject signed-out and stale workspace requests, and consume at most once. Calendar and list listeners use the same handoff.

platforms.macOS: Owns CapturePresentation.swift, Workspace/view integration, core tests and SwiftUI probe script.
platforms.iOS: Existing external capture already retains a WorkspaceBinding and consumes it on Inbox appearance/change; existing native external-capture evidence remains scoped. No iOS source change needed.

frameworkProbe.scope: Actual SwiftUI listener-pattern and owned capture-queue probe; no app/widget/URL dispatch.

storage.retained: Owned source/script, stage-independent probe inputs/executables/receipts, core/build logs; live v3 widget host/products untouched.

documentation.title: Apple onChange initial parameter
documentation.relevance: initial defaults to false and controls execution when the view first appears.

limits: Probe uses the same SwiftUI listener/view-identity pattern and actual owned queue source, not the complete Taskfold view or a URL event.
No browser custom protocol was dispatched; previous browser policy block was not bypassed.
No installed widget click, actual Inbox capture save, Mac warm/cold URL route or native account-switch pass is claimed.
Mac computer use remains locked. The original v3 widget test process and its window state are preserved; it does not yet contain this fix.
Builds are unsigned compile checks; APNs/distribution gates remain unchanged.
Build warnings are retained in the root logs; no warning-free build claim.
